data.fund_name: Groww Nifty India Railways PSU Index Fund
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long term capital growth by investing in securities of the Nifty India Railways PSU Index in the same proportion / weightage with an aim to provide returns before expenses that track the total return of Nifty India Railways PSU Index, subject to tracking errors. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved..
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related securities of companies constituting the underlying index - Nifty India Railways PSU Index - 95% to 100% - Very High Debt & Money Market Instruments / and Units of debt schemes / Units of Debt ETFs - 0% to 05% - Very High
